rules.name: d6 Aircraft Table
rules.description:
1-3	Ju-87 D or Ju-87 G Stuka
4	Fw-190 F
5	Hs-129 B
6	Player's Choice of Aircraft (Still roll for Armaments)

You may always choose an aircraft from lower on the table than your roll.  You must still roll for armament.
